title: gwo-global-2004-tv
label: Johnny K-9

won.source: Its card of 2 August 2004: Johnny K-9 beats Xtasy in the TV title match.

note: The page shows him with both TV belts on 9 August 2004; his loss is not on a held card.

won.source: Its card of 18 October 2004: Hellfire Jack hits the Spur and pins Gerard Angelo.

title: gwo-global-2004-tv
label: The Moose

won.source: Its card of 1 November 2004: The Moose clocks Gerard Angelo with brass knuckles in a three-way and pins him.

how: Won a three-way from Hellfire Jack and Gerard Angelo.

title: gwo-global-2004-tv
label: Hellfire Jack

won.source: Its card of 8 November 2004: Hellfire Jack pins The Moose with the Spur.

note: Tony Parizi strips him of the title on the card of 6 December 2004 after he is attacked in his dressing room.

won.source: Its card of 13 December 2004: Gerard Angelo is the last man in a nine-man battle royale for the vacated title.

title: gwo-global-2004-tv
label: Slim Pickens

won.source: Its evening card of Battle of the Warriors 2005: Slim Pickens pins the blinded Gerard Angelo in the first fall of a two-fall three-way.

how: Won the first fall of a two-fall three-way.
note: He is billed as TV champion on its card of 14 February 2005, the last in the mirror.

won.source: Billed as the TV champion on its card of 13 September 2004 with the new TV belt; his win is not on a held card.
Its card of 2 August 2004: Soul Reaver beats Radd Matthews for the Pacific title.

title: gwo-global-2004-pacific
label: Tex Murrphy

won.source: Its card of 16 August 2004: Tex Murrphy reverses Soul Reaver's pin into a small package.

note: His loss is not on a held card.

won.source: Its card of 20 September 2004: Rated R pins Radd Matthews with Dizz as the referee and is announced the Pacific champion.
Its card of 8 November 2004: Stevie James pins Rated R with the Stevie Splash.

title: gwo-global-2004-pacific
label: Radd Matthews

won.source: Its pay-per-view of 29 November 2004: Devanshi, in a referee's wig, counts a fast three for Radd Matthews after he chairs Stevie James.

how: Beat Stevie James with a substitute referee.

title: gwo-global-2004-pacific
label: Kosmic Kitty

won.source: Its card of 13 December 2004: Kosmic Kitty pins Radd Matthews with the Boo Boo Kitty.

note: Her loss is not on a held card.

won.source: Carries what the page calls his new and improved Pacific title on its card of 13 September 2004; his win is not on a held card.
Billed as the Pacific champion on its card of 14 February 2005; his win is not on a held card.

title: gwo-global-2004-canadian
label: Slim Pickens

won.source: Its card of 2 August 2004: Slim Pickens wins the Canadian title from Devo's side after Scavenger's entrance distracts Devo.

note: The first Canadian champion, as Slim Pickens says on 27 September 2004.

title: gwo-global-2004-canadian
label: Devo

won.source: Its card of 13 September 2004: Devo is the last man in an elimination tag for the Canadian title.

how: Won an elimination tag with Vesuvius.

won.source: Its card of 25 October 2004: Austin Fierro pins Slim Pickens in a three-way after Leech chairs Slim; Devo, the champion, is absent.

title: gwo-global-2004-canadian
label: Rated R

won.source: Its pay-per-view of 29 November 2004: Rated R pins Halloween Jack in a three-way with Austin Fierro.

how: Won a three-way without pinning the champion.
note: Billed as retaining it on 13 December 2004; Austin Fierro is billed as champion again on 14 February 2005 and the change is not on a held card.

won.source: Billed as the Canadian champion on its card of 14 February 2005; the change is not on a held card.

title: gwo-global-2004-world
label: Myst

won.source: Its pay-per-view Security Breach of 4 October 2004: Myst pins Devo in a three-way for the first GWO World title.

how: Won a three-way over Devo and Max Cameron.

won.source: Its pay-per-view Maximum Impact of 1 November 2004: Max Cameron pins Myst in a steel cage after Gerard Angelo and Slim Pickens interfere.
Its pay-per-view Bloodshed of 29 November 2004: Lethal Weapon pins Leech in a three-way with the champion Max Cameron.

title: gwo-global-2004-world
label: Sal Clemenzo

won.source: Its evening card of Battle of the Warriors 2005: Sal Clemenzo rolls up Lethal Weapon after Halloween Jack interferes.

note: He is billed as world champion on its card of 14 February 2005, the last in the mirror.

won.source: Its pay-per-view of 1 November 2004: Slim Pickens pins Leech when the lights come back on in a four-way for the new hardcore title.

title: gwo-global-2004-hardcore
label: Jack Spade

won.source: Its pay-per-view of 29 November 2004: Jack Spade pins Boomshalkalaka with the Jack of All Spades in a three-way with Slim Pickens.

note: He keeps it on 13 December 2004 and in the evening card of Battle of the Warriors 2005; his loss, if any, is not on a held card.

won.source: Its card of 2 August 2004: Bobby Banks pins Thunder with the Sudden Impact and the Regulators win the tag titles.

title: gwo-global-2004-tag-team
label: Thunder and Marla Storme

won.source: Its card of 16 August 2004: Marla Storme's shooting star press and Thunder's spear beat Devin Blade and Bobby Banks for the titles.

note: Devin Blade and Bobby Banks are billed as the champions again on 13 September 2004; the change is not on a held card.

title: gwo-global-2004-tag-team
label: Smooth Kriminals

won.source: Its card of 13 September 2004: Radd Matthews pins Devin Blade in the dark after the lights go out, and Crystal Braun counts three.

how: Won a tag title match in the dark.
note: The 8 November 2004 three-way ends in a double pin and Tony Parizi vacates the titles for an open match; the page does not say whether the Smooth Kriminals were the holders when he did.

won.source: Its pay-per-view of 29 November 2004: Matt Classic pins Gerard Angelo in the open three-team match for the vacant titles.

title: gwo-global-2004-tag-team
label: Thunder Storme

won.source: Its evening card of Battle of the Warriors 2005: Thunder pins Boomshalkalaka in a three-way with the champions Beyond Control.

note: Billed as the tag champions on 14 February 2005.
